notes.reason: The dates in the note are right: Dookie came out on 1 February 1994, Sum 41 formed in 1996, and their breakthrough came with "Fat Lip" and All Killer No Filler in 2001. But Hank does not assert three years as a fact. He says "And within what? 3 years? Sum 41?", which is him guessing out loud mid-sentence and inviting the audience to fill in the number, and he follows it with "You know?" and "I'm not critiquing Sum 41 in particular". His actual point is that the Gilman Street punk scene got sanded down into mass-appeal pop punk, and that point stands whether the gap was three years or seven. A reader who takes the correct number away from the video believes exactly the same thing about the argument. Correcting a spoken hedge on a detail that carries no weight is the kind of pedantry that makes the whole batch look bad.
